mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.id AS login_id, u.user_name, u.phone_number, s.delivery_address, s.birth_date FROM `user` u JOIN supporter s ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (id, pw, role, user_name, phone_number) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{password}, #{role}, #{userName}, #{phoneNumber})
INSERT INTO supporter (user_id, delivery_address, birth_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deliveryAddress}, #{birthDate})
